Synthetic, analyst-specified biochemical ODE model; not a published paper.
Time t is in minutes. States are dimensionless abstract activities. The fixed compartment has size 1 dimensionless.
Initial D = 1.0.
Parameter k = 0.3. The parameter table labels k per second, but the equally authoritative equation legend labels k per minute. No correction is available.
Equation dD/dt = -k*D.

Author clarification (supersedes the unresolved statement above):
The author corrects the table: Parameter k = 0.3 per minute; the per-second label was a typo. Use minutes without conversion.
